connector.name: Yungle
connector.registryDescription: Ask about your Yungle file deliveries - what was sent, who downloaded, what expires. Read-only.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package yungle-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace co.yungle, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: YUNGLE_API_KEY
env.description: A Yungle API key from https://yungle.co/dashboard/settings/api. Reading is free on any account; give the key read scopes only — this server has no tool that writes.

env.name: YUNGLE_API_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL. Only useful for development against a local Yungle instance; leave unset to use https://yungle.co/api/v1.
